knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The source explains that pests re-contaminate sanitised surfaces, so pest control comes before sanitising.
The source places ultimate responsibility with top management, which identifies a competent person and supports the programme.
The response is to stop, record and report. Treatment and clearance are decisions for the responsible person.

practicalCriteria: Learner responds to a simulated pest sign by stopping work, recording the location and reporting it (pass: no product applied, record and report completed).
Learner explains which decisions belong to the responsible person and which belong to the cleaner (pass: stated correctly).
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed sign record from the simulation
Observer note of the report made
Written explanation of the responsibility split
stopWorkCriteria: A pest sign is found and the area is being used for food handling.
A product is offered for application by a person without authority or training.
Stock near the sign is being moved before the responsible person has seen it.
The worker is asked to apply a pesticide near food or open packaging.
